overview: This House resolution formally expresses the House's deep sorrow at the death of Representative Sylvester Turner of Texas, who was serving in the House when he died. It directs the House Clerk to send the resolution to the Senate and a copy to his family, and it provides that the House adjourn for the day as a mark of respect to his memory. Resolutions like this are a long-standing House custom when a sitting member dies. The House agreed to it on March 5, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution is a customary and fitting way for the House to honor a colleague who died in office and to offer condolences to his family.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or spending.
